findings.title: Oracle Critical Security Patch Update Advisory - August 2026
findings.summary_md: Oracle released its August 2026 CSPU advisory, covering 943 patches for 925 unique CVEs across 23 product families, with 154 critical severity issues. The advisory page carries an updated-date meta of 13 August 2026 and references the monthly CSPU cycle that began in May 2026. It explicitly warns that attackers have exploited previously patched Oracle vulnerabilities when customers failed to apply updates.

findings.title: Oracle Critical Security Patch Update August 2026 | Tenable
findings.summary_md: Tenable's analysis of the August 2026 CSPU notes 925 CVEs addressed in 943 patches, with 154 critical updates, spanning 23 product families. It highlights Fusion Middleware receiving the highest patch count at 262 (27.8%) and compares the CSPU volume to earlier quarterly CPUs, showing the August release exceeds the April 2026 CPU. The post was published on 18 August 2026 at 20:41 UTC.
